eventRules.subsequentSide: Alternates after actual spawns; do not infer confidently after an unknown delay.
eventRules.action: Run it only when the crossing and drop-off can be covered.
eventRules.waitIf: The carrier is unsupported, the destination is threatened, or the urn has not landed.
eventRules.note: At a nominal checkpoint such as 15:00, an ongoing carry may delay the next spawn. Show a scheduled reminder, not an exact guaranteed availability countdown.

eventRules.initialReminder: Watch for the first Rift announcement around the early midgame.
eventRules.confidence: Approximate window inferred from wiki preview plus announcement delay; authored source uses a different first-window label.
eventRules.activeSide: Set Yellow or Green from the in-game announcement; both map markers are only candidate sites.
eventRules.action: Move with teammates toward the announced side; control the circle when it opens.
eventRules.waitIf: The event is not open or the team cannot safely contest.
eventRules.recurrence: Roughly seven-minute scheduled cadence with variation and possible event delays; never seven minutes after capture.

structureRules.required: Be close enough to damage it; no fixed unlock minute.
structureRules.recommend: Attack after winning lane space, usually behind your Troopers.
structureRules.waitIf: The enemy can punish you or you cannot approach safely.
structureRules.important: Lane Guardians do not have standard-mode backdoor protection. A wave is a safety and pressure recommendation, not a mandatory immunity unlock.

structureRules.required: Its corresponding Guardian must be destroyed. Approach within its vulnerable range.
structureRules.recommend: Push your wave forward to remove backdoor protection, then attack with a safe exit.
structureRules.waitIf: Guardian still stands, Protected is showing, or defenders can surround you.

structureRules.required: Reach an entrance safely and remove backdoor protection with a pushed lane.
structureRules.recommend: Help destroy a complete pair to unlock the Shrines.
structureRules.waitIf: The push lacks a wave or the team cannot stay together.

sources.label: May 22, 2026 update — official notes reproduced by the wiki

structureRules.required: At least one complete enemy Base Guardian pair must be destroyed; attack from inside the Shrine platform.
structureRules.recommend: Destroy both Shrines while your push keeps base protection down.
structureRules.waitIf: The pair prerequisite remains, the target is Protected, or reinforcements force a retreat.

structureRules.required: Both enemy Shrines must be destroyed; then finish the Patron's phases.
structureRules.recommend: Commit when the team can finish or hold the position through the transformation.
structureRules.waitIf: Shrines remain or the push has lost its safe window.
